name: backlog-pane
description: A live Backlog.md board in a Claude Code side pane (unofficial).

backlogPath.title: Backlog executable
backlogPath.description: Full path to the backlog executable. Leave empty to find it on PATH (and, on Windows, in npm's and bun's global folders).

doneLimit.title: Done tasks shown
doneLimit.description: How many of the most recent tasks in the final status to list when that group is expanded.
